HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Dialog.Title: Hero of the People
HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Settings.ReminderInte: How often (in minutes) the GM is prompted to initiate a hero vote.
HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Settings.VoteTimerEna: When enabled, votes auto-submit after the timer expires. When disabled, voting stays open until the GM ends it.
HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Settings.VoteTimerDur: How many seconds players have to vote before auto-submit. Only used when the vote timer is enabled.
HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Settings.HideSessionW: When enabled, players who have already received a hero point this session are hidden from the voting list instead of greyed out.
HERO_OF_THE_PEOPLE.Settings.ExcludedActo: Comma-separated list of character names to exclude from voting (e.g. companions, NPCs, or test characters). Names are case-insensitive.
